title: Virus-like particles observed assembling in real time
title_zh: 实时观察病毒样颗粒组装
abstract: Scientists have long dreamt of being able to track and analyse each step in the assembly of a virus’s protein shell. An ingenious experiment shows how this can be done.
abstract_zh: 科学家们长期以来一直梦想能够跟踪并分析病毒蛋白外壳组装的每一步。一次巧妙的实验展示了如何实现这一目标。
